sections.title: Listening. Listen to Aziz talking about a holiday. Are the sentences true or false?
sections.script:
Lola: Aziz, you've just come back from Turkey, haven't you?
Aziz: Yes! We went by train and bus because my dad doesn't like flying. It took two days, but we saw so many places on the way.
Lola: Two days! Weren't you bored?
Aziz: Not really. We stopped in three cities and did some sightseeing. But I didn't prepare well — I forgot to take a power bank, so my phone was always dead.
Lola: Where did you stay?
Aziz: In a small hotel near the sea. The staff were really friendly. The receptionist even taught me some Turkish words.
Lola: Have you ever been abroad before?
Aziz: No, this was my first time. The most useful thing I took was my sister's phrase book — I used it every day!

items.q: Aziz's family travelled by plane.
They visited other cities on the way.
Aziz was well prepared for the journey.
Aziz enjoyed talking to the hotel staff.
Aziz thinks the phrase book was the most useful thing.

sections.title: H. Read the posts. Who says each sentence? Choose the person.
sections.passage:
Kamola: I’ve visited twelve countries, but my favourite trip was to the mountains near my home. We stayed with a family and helped them with their animals.

Rustam: I love big cities. Last year I went to Istanbul and spent every day in museums. I didn’t go to the beach once!

Nigora: I’ve never been abroad. This summer I travelled around Uzbekistan by train with my sister. It was cheap and we met lots of friendly people.

Jasur: I went on a cruise with my parents. The ship was fantastic, but I got seasick and stayed in my cabin for two days.

items.q: Who was ill during the holiday?
Who has never left their country?
Who enjoyed culture more than the sea?
Who did some work during the holiday?
Who says the trip didn’t cost much?
